# subvolume: # A.R.K. package-owned code stays on the root filesystem under /opt/ark.
# Only mutable state is split into dedicated Btrfs subvolumes, so package
# installation can never be hidden by a mount at /opt/ark/runtime or /opt/ark/graveyard.
# /run/ark is volatile and is created by systemd tmpfiles at boot.
# /etc/ark is configuration and stays on the root filesystem.
# /ark and /opt/ARK are legacy migration inputs only and are intentionally not mounted.
